turns.say: What year is it right now?
What are the top tech news stories today?
Who won the most recent Formula 1 Grand Prix?
Who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup final, and in which country was it played?
My name is Himan and I am learning Rust.
I am testing whether you can recall timing.
How long ago did I send my first message in this chat?
turns.rubric: The answer gives a short, plausible duration (seconds or a few minutes) or says it was just now. It must not claim hours or days.

turns.say: I am planning a trip to Jaipur next month. Any tips?
What did I ask you about earlier today?
What was the very first question I ever asked you, back in 2023?
turns.rubric: The assistant must NOT invent a question from 2023. Acceptable: saying it has no record that far back, or mentioning only recent questions with their recent dates.
